komut: cd "." && grep -nE "README|şablon|süre|rozet|Netlify'ın|36/36|36 " docs/*.md | cut -c1-220; grep -nE "^\| K3|Netlify sağ alt|^## " AI_LOG.md | cut -c1-120

komut: cd "." && sed -n '96,99p;131,136p;170,174p;211,222p' AI_LOG.md; sed -n '82,90p' docs/TASARIM-RAPORU.md

aciklama: Check log summary for unreadable lines and diff size
komut: cd "." && npm run -s ai-log:ozet 2>&1 | tail -8; git diff --stat

aciklama: Count unreadable lines in event log
komut: cd "." && npm run -s ai-log:ozet 2>&1 | grep -iE "okunamad|satır|bozuk|olay" | head -5; node -e 'const l=require("fs").readFileSync("ai-log/olaylar.jsonl","utf8").split("\n");let b=[];l.forEach((s,i)=>{if(!s.trim())return;try{JSON.parse(s)}catch{b.push(i+1)}});console.log("toplam satır",l.length,"okunamayan",b.join(","))'

Run lint, type check and unit tests
komut: cd "." && npm run -s lint 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "lint çıkış: $?"; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "tsc çıkış: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; npx vitest run 2>&1 | grep -E "Tests|Test Files"

komut: cd "." && npm run -s test:e2e 2>&1 | grep -vE "^\s+✓" | tail -15; TZ=UTC-3 date "+%H.%M"; netstat -ano | grep -E ":3217 .*LISTEN" || echo "3217 kapalı"

komut: cd "." && grep -nE "DATABASE_URL|500" playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/sunucu.spec.ts | head -6
